sqlMap.select: SELECT dev_info.id, name, raindate, daysum FROM (SELECT * FROM dev_info WHERE distcode=#cityCode# AND id IN (SELECT id FROM rain_accdata)) AS dev_info LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM rain_accdata WHERE daysum > 0 AND (raindate >= #beginDateCondition# and raindate <= #endDateCondition#) or raindate = DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y%m%d') or raindate = DATE_FORMAT(date_add(now(), interval -1 day), '%Y%m%d')) AS rain_accdata ON dev_info.id=rain_accdata.id ORDER BY name, raindate

SELECT dev_info.id, name, mountName, snowdate, daysum FROM (SELECT * FROM dev_info WHERE distcode=#cityCode# AND id IN (SELECT id FROM snow_snow_new)) AS dev_info LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM snow_snow_new WHERE daysum > 0 AND (snowdate >= #beginDateCondition# and snowdate <= #endDateCondition#) or snowdate = DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y%m%d') or snowdate = DATE_FORMAT(date_add(now(), interval -1 day), '%Y%m%d')) AS snow_snow_new ON dev_info.id=snow_snow_new.id ORDER BY name, snowdate
